summary: No gossip or FD event triggers dispatch in 5.0.9. A periodic 10 s HintsDispatchTrigger keeps stores that are isLive (endpoint known and FD alive) and have files, and delivered files are deleted. The model reproduces this: dispatch when up, skip when down, nothing on the UP event, delivery on the next pass.

Down for more than 3h means no hint, and that case is reproduced. The persistent-window branch is wrong. storage-proxy.should-hint compares epoch_ms_at_start + now - window (epoch ms) with hint creation_time (sim-clock ms), so once any hint for the host is in hints-store, every later hint is refused, even for a node down 1 minute. Also, gossiper.endpoint-state-mark-dead resets down_since_ms on every markAlive attempt, which restarts the hint-window clock.

hinted_handoff_enabled=false: nothing is hinted and the write outcome is unchanged. Refinement: at CL ANY with all replicas down, the code waits 2000 ms for WriteTimeout, then hintMutations hints nobody and returns success, so the write is stored nowhere. The model gets success through the same ANY path, but abstract-write-response-handler.get fails immediately (45 ms) instead of waiting out the write timeout.

Heartbeat bump, digests for all endpoints, SYN to one live member, probabilistic SYN to an unreachable member and to a seed (never when self is the only seed), then doStatusCheck. The SYN->ACK, ACK->ACK2 and ACK2-apply legs are each reproduced as separate flows. A cross-node conversation in one run needs per-node state (sim gap).

Conviction happens when PHI_FACTOR*phi > 8 (about 18.4 s of silence at a 1 s mean): no conviction at 18 s, conviction at 18.5 s, none after a local pause. markDead then StorageService.onDead, which interrupts outbound connections and sends DOWN to clients. Correction: hints are not a gossip subscriber; dispatch stops through FD.isAlive in isLive/shouldAbort, and the model does this too.

BOOT plus tokens gossiped, a 30 s RING_DELAY, stream, then NORMAL. Peers record bootstrap tokens and pending ranges, writes include the pending replica with blockFor 3, and NORMAL moves the node into the ring. Wrong: range-streamer.fetch-async streams from every live member, including itself (RangeStreamer excludes the local node and picks a source per range). stream-plan.execute carries no ranges (contract), so nothing is fetched.

Correction: in the 3-node RF-3 benchmark cluster a non-forced decommission is refused with DECOMMISSION_FAILED (reproduced), and hints are transferred after the batchlog replay, concurrently with the data stream. With 4 nodes the model reproduces LEAVING, 30 s, batchlog, stream, hints, LEFT, 30 s, DECOMMISSIONED, and peers see LEAVING (pending ranges) and LEFT (removed, hints excised). Wrong: storage-service.unbootstrap hard-codes stream-plan.execute peers: [], so no data goes to the new owners.
